svg.aria-label: The A string in A major: the 1st finger lands on B in 1st position, C sharp in 2nd, D in 3rd, E in 4th and F sharp in 5th; 4th position plays E, F sharp, G sharp, A and 5th position plays F sharp, G sharp, A, B. Below, the silent-shift drill: open A, D, F sharp, D, B
svg.text: Up the A string to 4th and 5th position
A major notes. Each position starts the hand one note higher. 4th and 5th are new at Grade 5.
From Chapter 2 of this post. Positions 1-3 (posts 01 and 04) shown with A major notes for comparison. Not to scale.
